prompt:
Create ONE native transparent RGBA PNG refined natural-ink2.5D fighting-game creature sprite atlas of TRACKER from METAL GEAR SURVIVE2018, as faithful to the supplied original creature references as possible. First images are the actual original appearance authority; LAST image is only line/painting and sixteen-pose atlas STYLE/SPACING. NEVER copy Armstrong's identity, face, shirt, tie, muscles or human head. This is a dark crystalline non-human enemy from the released game, not a cyborg costume, generic fantasy monster or cute zombie.
IDENTITY AND ANATOMY: Original2018 Tracker. Grey exposed human-derived narrow torso, humanoid bare arms, jagged black crystal collar/headmass and elongated glowing-red pointed head crystal, no visible ordinary human face. Dark ragged trouser/hip covering and BLACK mutation-heavy lower legs as in official jumping capture. Lower legs remain visibly mutated and lean, not human army boots/exosuit. Exactly two arms and two legs. Agile contorted crouch/leap poses retain the same creature silhouette. No gun, vest, helmet, sci-fi robot or new equipment.
SOURCE QUALIFICATION: Official source directly establishes mutated dark legs, torso, arms and red crystal head; precise feet and hidden reverse surfaces are conservative source-led reconstruction.
FACING: all16 creature bodies and forward actions independently drawn facing SCREEN LEFT. Preserve anatomical sides and asymmetric crystal deposits. Do not mirror another completed atlas. No ordinary face where crystalline growth replaces the head.
STRICT ATLAS: square page, exactly4equalcolumns x4equalrows, exactly16 separate complete connected head-to-feet figures. At least45fullytransparentpixels outer border and40transparentpixels between figures. One figure in each cell; figure maximum~220pixels high and225pixels wide within~320pixel cell, including all crystals/head/hands/feet. Every head-tip and foot/hand complete. All poses consistent bodily scale. Compact bent-knee kicks and folded KO; long appendages remain folded so figures stay inside cells. Each figure is one connected silhouette. No disconnected crystal shards, rubble, drops or detached limbs.
EXACT ROW-MAJOR POSES: row1col1 prowling stand, row1col2 guarded crouch, row1col3 rapid walk stride A, row1col4 rapid walk stride B; row2col1 very low crouch, row2col2 springing windup, row2col3 leaping short swipe with knees folded, row2col4 low folded-leg kick; row3col1 reaching grasp, row3col2 airborne folded-knee pounce, row3col3 landing with bent knees, row3col4 compact jump guard; row4col1 reset from landing, row4col2 hit recoil, row4col3 curled complete prone KO, row4col4 crouched getup.
True alpha0 background and all gutters. No labels, digits, grid, ground shadow, scenery, particles, attack effects, glowing halo, external muzzleflash, explosion or extra people. The attached red crystal can be intrinsically luminous, but NO external glow or particles outside body. Mutant anatomy only; no new equipment, firearm, armour plates or human face. Row4col3 knockout includes complete head-to-feet silhouette and both legs. Row3col3 reset and all crouches retain whole body. Body connected, native source pixels, no resizing/cropping/processing of the supplied sources. Highest useful native output resolution; 16actual independently authored poses, not repeated sprite clones.
